rewrittenStatement: Penultimate-year Data Science student with hands-on experience building reproducible analytics workflows in Python and SQL, with a strong interest in applying statistical modelling to improve patient outcomes. Through academic and project work, I have delivered end-to-end analyses from messy dataset cleaning to model evaluation and clear stakeholder communication. I am motivated by Roche's focus on evidence-led healthcare and would bring a practical, collaborative approach to supporting cross-functional teams with high-quality data insights during my placement year.
